description: Actions available at a decision node. `history` is an action path ending in the position about to act, e.g. "UTG_60%_HJ". sizeBb is the raise-to in big blinds and sizePctPot is the percent of the pot after calling (nlmtt8 40bb Open 40034 is 2.19bb; the pack label is 2.2x). evs are small blinds relative to fold. Compact mode returns action totals; add `hand` for its exact mixed strategy. full=true is full=1: all 169 hold'em hands with explicit 0, and no invented EVs.

detail.description: Response detail. "compact" is the default and removes bulk maps; use "full" only when exact complete data is required.

full.description: Hold'em only. When true, each action includes all 169 hands with weight 0 where the bundle omitted the hand. EVs stay only where the bundle scored them.

game.description: "nl" = no-limit hold'em 6-max cash (169-grid hands, per-hand EV in small blinds), "nl9" = no-limit hold'em 9-max cash, "nlmtt8" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT chip-EV (10–300bb, 1bb BB-ante; Fold/Call/Limp/AI/Open/3B tokens), "nlh8-hydra" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT chip-EV with a classic 0.1bb ante from every seat (10, 20, 30, 60bb; same tokens as nlmtt8), "plo" = pot-limit Omaha 6-max cash (4-card), "plo5" = pot-limit Omaha 5-card 6-max (100bb, 1.2bb ante), "plo9" = pot-limit Omaha 9-max cash, "plo6hu" = 6-card Omaha heads-up (BTN vs BB, 100bb). Cash trees are not tournament, ICM, PKO, or satellite solves. nlmtt8 is chip-EV only.

history.description: Action path ending in a position

name: get_node

outputSchema.description: Every action at one preflop decision node.

items.description: One action available at a preflop node.

evSb.description: EV in small blinds for the requested hand, if scored.

additionalProperties.description: EV in small blinds relative to folding.

evs.description: Hand class to EV, only where the solved bundle scored the hand.

frequency.description: Frequency for the requested hand, or the action total.

sizeBb.description: Raise-to size in big blinds, for raising actions.

sizePctPot.description: Raise size as a percent of the pot after calling.

weights.description: Hand class to frequency. An omitted class has weight 0.

actor.description: Position to act at this node.

continuingCombos.description: Combos that continue past this node.

continuingHands.description: Hand classes that continue past this node.

hand.description: The requested hand, when one was asked for.

hint.description: How to narrow, page, or widen the same query.

history.description: Action path ending in the acting position.

spot.description: Action path ending in an action, echoed from the request.

units.description: Unit labels: stack and sizeBb in bb, evs in sb.

version.description: Dataset version where the bundle publishes one.

title: Get preflop decision node
